c.tagline: Queen of the Arabian Sea — Chinese fishing nets, spice warehouses, and layers of colonial history.

taxi.fareNote: App cabs (Uber, Ola) are cheap and reliable on the mainland. Auto-rickshaws are everywhere and metered by law, but drivers often quote a flat fare — agree the price or insist on the meter before setting off, especially around Fort Kochi.

emergency.note: 112 is India's single all-services emergency number; 108 reaches a free state ambulance and 101 the fire service.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

avoid.reason: Auto-rickshaw drivers around Fort Kochi and Ernakulam may inflate fares or detour to commission shops — agree fares or use apps.

hood_desc: The atmospheric old peninsula of cantilevered Chinese fishing nets, Portuguese and Dutch colonial houses, St Francis Church, Kathakali theatres, and the Biennale art scene; the historic heart most visitors come for.

Just south of Fort Kochi, a warren of spice godowns, antique dealers along Jew Town, the 16th-century Paradesi Synagogue, and the mural-filled Mattancherry (Dutch) Palace; best for heritage browsing and shopping.
The busy commercial mainland across the harbour, centered on MG Road with malls, jewellers, restaurants, and the main railway and metro links; the practical, well-connected base for the modern city.
A landscaped waterfront promenade in Ernakulam facing the backwaters, lined with hotels, malls, and evening food stalls, with ferries and sunset boat cruises departing nearby; lively after dark.
A tranquil man-made island between Ernakulam and Fort Kochi holding the port, naval base, and a handful of waterfront resorts; calm and green, a quiet retreat close to the ferries.

water.note: Drink bottled or filtered water; avoid tap water and street ice.

transit.pay: The Kochi Metro and the electric-boat Water Metro share the rechargeable Kochi1 card and QR tickets bought via the app; single metro fares run about ₹10–60 (US$0.12–0.70). City buses take cash, and auto-rickshaws and app cabs increasingly accept UPI/QR payments.
transit.hours: The metro runs roughly 6:00am to 10:00pm and Water Metro ferries from early morning to about 9:00pm; buses run late but frequency thins after dark, when app cabs and autos take over.
transit.note: Kochi spreads across islands and backwaters, so getting around blends the modern elevated Metro, the newer battery-powered Water Metro ferries, traditional passenger ferries, city buses, and ubiquitous auto-rickshaws.

transit.m: Prepaid taxi or app cab to Ernakulam/Fort Kochi (45–70 min)
KSRTC AC airport bus to Ernakulam
Aluva Metro station shuttle + Kochi Metro to city

tip.r: ~10% at restaurants if no service charge is added; ₹50–100 for hotel porters and small rounding-up for auto and taxi drivers is appreciated.
